independence_basis: Separate examination of the supplied schema-conversion ZIP, all included file hashes, approved membership records and annotation manifest, and inspected FastChat preprocess/dataset code; recomputation of reported membership and annotation counts plus source-function synthetic contract tests. No access to the original raw source corpus or cluster model, and no conversion performed.
scope: Authorize only materialization of the specified 1,858-record id/conversations native corpus by dropping each turn loss field, preserving its original annotations in an immutable audit manifest, and CPU validation. No model training or inference is authorized.

supervision_assessment.trainer_reads: example["conversations"] and for each turn reads "from" and "value"; labels are set from tokenizer IDs then human/instruction segments are masked
supervision_assessment.interpretation: The 4,671 assistant turns tagged loss:false are not excluded from supervision by the inspected FastChat trainer. Removing loss does not change that trainer behavior. Their tokens are eligible for the same assistant-target labels as loss:true turns, conditional on native tokenizer/template alignment; a mismatch can mask an entire example.
supervision_assessment.original_annotation_intent: Not established. loss:false may have been intended by the dataset authors to mask these turns; this review does not infer that intent or approve the supervision policy for model training.
supervision_assessment.exact_token_mask_status: Not verified; run the pinned native preprocess/label-mask audit over the fully materialized corpus and require zero unapproved truncation, unresolved boundaries, or label mismatches before training review.

findings.detail: The in-memory projection manifest has exactly 1,858 retained rows. For every retained row, source-row index, source ID and original record SHA digest match the approved membership in original ascending order. Eight exclusions match the previously approved quarantine; the 1,866-row partition is complete.

Inspected conversion_draft() constructs native records as {id, conversations:[{from,value},...]}; preserves text verbatim and turn sequence; only removes loss at the native turn level. It rejects unexpected turn/record keys, nonalternating roles, empty retained assistant responses and mismatched source hashes. The ZIP does not contain the original source conversations or a written native corpus; the proposed full native corpus digest must be verified when materialized.

All 28,692 retained turns have per-turn original_loss_annotations indexed by turn and role. Recomputed counts: 14,346 human loss:null, 9,675 GPT loss:true, 4,671 GPT loss:false. No missing annotation entries or role/order inconsistencies were found in the supplied manifest.

findings.topic: 4,671 loss:false assistant turns and native supervision
findings.detail: Inspected FastChat train.py preprocess() uses from/value, not loss, and applies assistant-target loss to all eligible GPT spans. Therefore loss:false does not suppress those 4,671 assistant turns. Removing the annotation leaves this behavior unchanged. Actual native masks depend on tokenizer/template alignment and can be entirely zeroed for mismatched examples; this review does not certify all 4,671 will receive nonzero token supervision, nor that original authors intended such training.

The supplied 10 payload files match ZIP manifest SHA-256 and byte lengths; the draft, policy, reviewer approval and context-report hash links match. Authorize only CPU materialization and exact integrity checks; stop without training or registry mutation on any source/projection/annotation mismatch.

Original raw source text and projected native output were not in the review bundle; their content equality is enforced by the conversion algorithm but not independently authenticated. Clean provenance, split independence, native label masks at 4,096, matched recipes/controls, hardware approval and execution remain outside this review.
